name: markdown-exactness-unresolved
body: The markdown frontend must preserve the exactness posture of the code frontends: an edge is emitted only where a link or a containment resolves to a project node. A link that cannot be resolved yields an UnresolvedTarget with a category, never a fabricated FQN, exactly as never-fabricate-edges and exactness-no-heuristic require; there is no heuristic link resolution and no provenance/confidence tier. AC: the broken-link fixture produces only unresolved_use edges to UnresolvedTargets and no guessed uses edge.
